result.title: Run long tasks in Codex using goals
result.description:
Goal mode (/goal) has graduated from an experiment—for tasks big and small, Codex gets your work done. 

Use goal mode in the Codex app, IDE Extension, or CLI to give Codex a specific milestone, and it will keep working until it gets there, even across hours or days.

You can check in and steer, and even pause Codex along the way.

result.title: Share Codex plugins with your team
result.description:
Teams can now distribute custom plugins, reuse internal tools, and manage what’s available across their workspace.

If you have a plugin that's working for you, now its really simple to share it with others right from within the Codex app.

Chapters
00:00 Launching plugin sharing in Codex
00:09 Sharing a custom plugin from the directory
00:19 Choosing who can access the plugin
00:39 Finding plugins shared by teammates
01:06 Sharing curated directory URLs
01:24 Team workflows do not have to stay local

result.title: Introducing Appshots in Codex
result.description:
Appshots are a new way to bring the context of what you’re working on into Codex.

On your Mac, press Command-Command to attach your app window to a Codex thread. Codex gets both a screenshot and text from the window, including content beyond what’s visible onscreen.

Appshots are available across plans on Mac, with enterprise access coming soon.

result.title: Built with GPT-5.5: Abridge Clinical AI Notes
result.description:
A better medical note starts with a very human reality: people do not tell stories in a straight line.

Matt Sanders from Abridge shares how GPT-5.5 helps extract the facts that matter from provider-patient conversations, supporting more complete notes with less documentation burden.
